title: Precision Restrictive Clauses in Statutory Drafting
goal: I can state a condition with *feltéve, hogy* and an exception with *kivéve, ha*.
I can say that a rule applies only in one case with *kizárólag abban az esetben, amennyiben*.
I can use *azzal a feltétellel, hogy* for a condition on consent.
